templates.title: Login
templates.description: Wave header artwork, a shadowed input card, gradient sign-in button, social row and staggered fade-in animations.

templates.title: Sign up
templates.description: Full-screen gradient with translucent blobs, a rounded white sheet with outlined fields, a terms checkbox and a solid call to action.

templates.title: Onboarding
templates.description: Three swipeable pages with original illustrations, page dots and a round gradient next button.

templates.title: Profile
templates.description: Cover artwork with an overlapping avatar, stats card, follow / message buttons and a gradient grid of recent work.

templates.title: Dashboard
templates.description: Greeting header, gradient balance card, quick actions, a bar chart built from containers and recent transactions with a bottom navigation bar.

templates.title: Product list
templates.description: Search field, promo banner, horizontal category chips and a two-column product grid with original product artwork.

templates.title: Product details
templates.description: Large product artwork on a radial glow (Hero), rating stars, colour swatches, quantity stepper and an add-to-cart button on a rounded sheet.

templates.title: Settings
templates.description: Gradient account card and grouped rounded sections with tinted icon boxes, switches, a slider and a log-out action.

templates.title: Chat
templates.description: Conversation with gradient / white bubbles that slide in from their side, a typing indicator and a rounded message bar.
